name: peek-t1985-s2
cmd: set -e; for st in '' _late; do {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s2_cropat$st --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s2$st --out {out}/desk_tempho_1985_s2_cropat$st --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --tag _p96; done
summarize: for st in '' _late; do {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --summarize {out}/desk_tempho_1985_s2_cropat$st | grep -E 'TREATMENT|DESK gain|^desk_tempho|  desk '; done
note: E048 peek: T0 1986 seed 2 CropAT-DESK vs its control, paired (raw change, within readout, beyond placebo, beyond strong base)
